opportunities.name: Resy restaurant or event reservation
opportunities.description: Pick a city on Resy, find a restaurant or event by search or browsing, choose a ticket or party size and a time slot or ticket tier, then reserve it.
steps: Open the Resy homepage and click the city selector in the header
Choose the target city from the Popular Cities list
Click the search box, or open a collection such as 'View all <city> Restaurants'
Click the restaurant or event result
Set the ticket or party size using the tickets dropdown
Click the time slot button, or the 'Book Now' button for a ticket tier
Click 'Reserve Now' (or 'Log in' if prompted) to start the reservation
parameters: time slot or ticket tier (e.g. Centurion Member, 5:00 PM)

instances.values: City: Miami. Event: 'Thursday, May 4th | American Express Presents CARBONE BEACH 2023'. Tickets: 3. Tier: Centurion Member Access, then Reserve Now (order summary $9,810). Reached via 'View all Miami Restaurants'.
City: Atlanta. Event: 'HAPPY HOUR BURGER' (Aria), Thu Apr 13 2023. Tickets: 1. Time slot: 5:00 PM, then Reserve Now. Reached via 'See more' in Special Events.
City: Columbus, OH. Search: 'Tsiakkos & Charcoal'. Opened the restaurant page and clicked 'View All (10)' photos. Partial: no reservation was made in this occurrence.

opportunities.name: NPS park lookup by state, then open a park sub-page
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, pick a US state from the 'Find a Park by State' dropdown, open the state's listing, then follow one of its park or heritage-area links to a detail page.
steps: Open nps.gov and click the 'By State...' 'Find a Park by State' control
Click the target state name in the dropdown list
On the state page, click the desired park or heritage area entry
On the park page, click the sub-link, such as 'Basic Information', 'Current Conditions', or '1 National Heritage Area'
parameters: which park or heritage-area entry to open
which sub-link to follow on the park page

instances.values: State: Alaska. Followed '1 National Heritage Area', then 'Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm National Heritage Area'.
State: Florida. Followed the park entry's 'Current Conditions »' link (Dry Tortugas / Everglades listing).
State: California. Followed 'Basic Information »' on the California National Historic Trail listing.

opportunities.name: Megabus track a bus by service number
opportunities.description: On megabus.com, open the Track my bus page, switch to the Service Number tab, enter a service or route number, and search for the bus.
steps: Open megabus.com and click 'Check my bus'
Click the 'Search by Service Number' field and type the service number
If a suggestion appears, click the matching suggestion (e.g. the stop or route)
